key_idea: Move the kangaroo and the rabbit one turn at a time.
steps: The kangaroo starts on step 1 and the rabbit on step 13.
Turn 1: the kangaroo goes up 4 to step 5. The rabbit goes down 3 to step 10.
Turn 2: the kangaroo goes up 4 to step 9. The rabbit goes down 3 to step 7.

choice_feedback.C: The rabbit stops on 10, 7, 4. It never stops on step 6.
choice_feedback.E: The rabbit stops on 10, 7, 4. It never stops on step 8.
